findings.reason: Verified: `.small-action` is now flex, `.small-action-desc` has no grow or width, and the edit/delete buttons float right inside it, so on short actions they sit right after the text instead of at the 755px row's right edge.

Verified the mobile `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` rule still applies, and the desktop padding change removes the 4em offset it was compensating for, so the message can extend over the 45px icon column; overlap depends on vertical position, so it is real but narrower.

The `-ms-align-items` line is a non-existent property and can be dropped, but the claims about legacy `-moz-box` gaps and `margin-left: auto` concern obsolete browsers and are speculative, so this is minor cleanup.

Verified that `float` on a flex item is ignored, so `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` is dead; the `clear: both` claim is partly wrong because clear on the flex container itself still acts against preceding floats.
